units.source_text: “不，我可不是只对太太生气……

en.t: No, it is not just your wife I am angry with...

units.source_text: 我气不过这种阴谋手段，他们以为加一把锁就可以把一个人关起来。

en.t: I cannot stomach this kind of scheming; they think they can lock a person up just by adding a padlock.

units.source_text: 你听懂了吗？

en.t: Do you understand what I am saying?

units.source_text: 不要紧，你没听懂也没关系。

en.t: Never mind, it does not matter if you do not understand.

units.source_text: 那我就来讲个滑稽事情给你听听吧……

en.t: Then let me tell you a funny story...

units.source_text: 以前，我家里养过一条杂种狗……

en.t: Once, we kept a mongrel dog at home...

units.source_text: 浑身长满浓浓的毛，到了夏天，它也丝毫不脱毛……

en.t: Its whole body was covered in thick fur, and even in summer it did not shed at all...

units.source_text: 看一眼都让人厌烦难受，所以，我一狠心都给它剪了……

en.t: Just looking at it made me feel fed up and uncomfortable, so I hardened my heart and clipped it all off...

units.source_text: 终于都剪完了，正准备把剪下来的毛扔掉，

en.t: At last I had finished cutting it all, and was just about to throw the clipped fur away,

units.source_text: 谁知那条狗忽然哀叫起来，

en.t: when suddenly the dog began to whine pitifully,

units.source_text: 谁也不知它打什么主意，

en.t: and no one knew what it had in mind,

units.source_text: 只见它一口叼起扎成一束的毛屑，

en.t: but then it picked up the bundled clippings in its mouth,

units.source_text: 迅速往自己的狗窝里跑进去……

en.t: and quickly ran back into its own doghouse...

units.source_text: 恐怕它觉得那些毛屑也是它身体上的一部分，

en.t: It probably thought those clippings were still part of its own body,

units.source_text: 这才难舍难分吧。”

en.t: and that was why it could not bear to part with them."

units.source_text: 说着，他偷偷瞟了一眼那女人的表情。

en.t: As he said this, he secretly glanced at the woman's expression.

units.source_text: 女人不自然地拧着身子弯着腰，纹丝不动。

en.t: The woman twisted her body unnaturally, bent at the waist, and did not move a muscle.

units.source_text: “算了，不说了……

en.t: Forget it, I will stop talking...

units.source_text: 人呐，谁身上都有一条在别人身上行不通的歪理……

en.t: Everyone has some warped logic inside them that would never work on anyone else...

units.source_text: 想扫沙也好，想做其他事也好，都请自便，尽管去做。

en.t: If you want to sweep sand, fine; if you want to do something else, do as you please, go right ahead.

units.source_text: 可我是绝对忍受不了的。

en.t: But I absolutely cannot put up with it.

units.source_text: 已经够多的了！

en.t: I have had more than enough!

units.source_text: 反正我立刻就想走……

en.t: In any case, I want to leave right now...

units.source_text: 你可别小看哟……

en.t: Do not underestimate me...

units.source_text: 要是有这份心思，从这里逃出去也是小菜一碟……

en.t: If I set my mind to it, escaping from here would be a piece of cake...

units.source_text: 正好香烟也断档了……”

en.t: Besides, I have just run out of cigarettes..."
